blocks.text: Era Zero is not yet ready for a broad English translator. It still requires: explicit approval or revision of every release atom; typed compound architecture and a high-frequency compound dictionary; an English sense index with declared gaps; a versioned utterance IR and executable grammar; deterministic renderer/decoder round-trip conformance; a controlled-English compiler with structured errors; and only then general-English ranking, ambiguity handling, and clarification. Glyph and audio rendering follow semantic stability.

A limited explicit-ID renderer may be prototyped now over the 45 canonical roots only if it rejects provisional roots, unapproved compounds, and underspecified grammar. It must not be presented as a general translator.
Next semantic block after decisions on the two pending packets: MAT:100–122. No MAT:100–122 review, Gate 4 compound work, or translator implementation was begun in this packet.
